issues: Folder labels are trusted. If a maxi skirt was saved under one-piece/dress (or palazzo pants under skirt), move that file — this trainer does not guess from filenames.
notes: There is no bottomwear/jeans folder. Denim lives in bottomwear/pants and is trained as trousers (Pants/Trousers).
The general clothing_mobilenetv2.keras is not required. This specialist only learns the three silhouettes that ImageNet + geometry mix up.
Do not vertically flip or heavily crop: that hides waist vs shoulders and the crotch gap between trouser legs.
